about: Hand-curated public places that are not in the census-style city table: regions, resorts, parks and a few small towns. No people and no private addresses. Merged with cities.json in the browser (site/js/pins/gazetteer.js).
license: Original curation (CC0). Coordinates are rounded to two decimals; ids of GeoNames rows (CC-BY-4.0, see LICENSES.md) are cited, not copied.
fields: id (stable string), name, kind, admin (US state or CA province letters), cc, lat, lon, w (rank weight, same scale as the population-in-hundreds column of cities.json), aliases (optional extra search names), replaces (optional GeoNames ids dropped because this entry names the same place better), source ({type: geonames|midpoint|map, ids: GeoNames ids of the cities.json rows, note})
